meta.title: Barley Pipeline
meta.name: barley
meta.lede: Western Canadian barley from CGC weekly data: producer deliveries, exports by port, terminal receipts, malting and processing, domestic feed shipments and commercial stocks.
notes: Malting & processing is barley processed at CGC-licensed process elevators (“Milled/Mfg Grain”), mostly malt plants.
Most barley is fed on farms or sold directly to feedlots, which CGC does not track.
